title: WannaCry hurt hospitals through unpatched known holes
body: The 2017 WannaCry worm spread via an SMB vulnerability for which Microsoft had issued a patch two months earlier, even for older systems amid the emergency. The NHS cancelled thousands of appointments as machines encrypted. The malware's kill-switch domain, found by Marcus Hutchins, halted it; the unpatched exposure, not the worm's novelty, did the damage.
source_hint: UK National Audit Office report on WannaCry (2017)
